content.text:
My place search is down tonight, so this comes from web guides, not from the app's own listings — and they're a few years old, so treat the details as a starting point.

Veggies Abroad and Midnight Blue Elephant both point to the Jalan Sugriwa area of central Ubud as the veg-friendly strip, with several fully vegetarian and vegan kitchens around there; Vegan Food Quest mentions a casual Balinese spot on Jalan Sugriwa too. I'd rather not name small family places, so: walk or ride into central Ubud along Jalan Sugriwa and pick from what's open — and if you want it checked properly, terima kasih (thank you (Indonesian)) for the patience while I try the app's own search again later.
